coaching.headline: The allied duo lane ran over Legion and Phase early, and Wraith's closing triple kill was the last fight before the enemy surrendered.

flags.text: Duo lane: four enemy duo deaths before minute ten, none allied; Sparrow scored three of the four.
Wraith dealt the game's most hero damage, 13,089, and closed on a damn triple kill: Legion, Phase, Akeron.
Khaimera, Sparrow and Wraith won 3-0 in the enemy half, then Khaimera took the first Fangtooth.
Akeron killed Wraith and Khaimera, then took the second Fangtooth during the 4-1 allied win at that pit.

focus.title: Win the pit fight and the Fangtooth
focus.action: Before each Fangtooth, Khaimera, Wraith and the duo group at the pit and open with Steel's Shield Slam into Cull, aiming to take the fight and the Fangtooth together.

8.7.call: Our jungler and both damage dealers went 3-0 and the Fangtooth followed, one of only two won fights cashed out of five. Repeat that conversion after every won fight.

13.3.call: Two separate plays on the duo lane and mid went 4-2, and the enemy duo outer tower fell next. After that tower, the sound call is a reset and a group before the Fangtooth.

14.7.call: Steel's kill on The Fey at the pit came before Akeron's Fangtooth take; Wraith's three kills came after. Next pit fight, one hero hits the Fangtooth while the rest fight.

c8332233-dd6f-4524-ac1b-a273cbae1677: One death all game, to Akeron on mid, against a deaths norm above five. In fights, stay spread out, not grouped in a line.
The game's top hero damage still ran 30% under the 1166 per-minute norm. On picks, fire Knock, Knock! right after Khaimera's Cull suppress lands.
5bd25494-c2b6-4b66-b80e-48c70045a6ac: Killed four of the five enemy heroes and led allies with 5082 objective damage. When Legion and Phase are both dead, spend the window on the duo tower.
Hero damage ran 27% under the 1000 per-minute norm, and the pit death came to Phase. Into the next Fangtooth, stand behind Steel's engage and fire from there.
7abb0d85-3518-4fc7-b092-6d96002ae365: First blood on The Fey, the first Fangtooth and both allied Seedlings: sharp jungle tempo. Keep opening that way whenever the duo lane is ahead.
The one death, to Akeron in the enemy jungle, preceded the enemy Fangtooth. Before the next Fangtooth, stay on the allied side of the pit until Cull is ready.
e5d4650e-e858-4870-8578-27590890c660: The shit spot: 6% kill participation and both offlane deaths in the allied half, one to Aurora outside any detected fight. Until Khaimera shows, hold near the tower.
No finished item beyond the crest and 5405 gold, lowest among allies. Against Aurora, finish Mistmeadow Buckler first and trade only after Hoarfrost is spent.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: 59% kill participation, zero deaths before minute ten, 3392 healing and an allied-high 9726 mitigated. Keep that frontline standard while the duo lane is ahead.
Seven wards against an 11.8 norm and zero enemy wards cleared. Before each Fangtooth, fill the full ward cap on the pit approaches.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Akeron Web Lash (root 1s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Peekaboo! to mark, reveal and slow → Knock, Knock! snipe on the marked target → Back It Up! to drag a fleeing hero back
ourKits.winCondition: land Knock, Knock! on Peekaboo!-marked targets for max-health damage and reset Surprise, Surprise! on takedowns
ourKits.passive: his vision item becomes a camouflaged Sonar Drone that reveals enemies through walls
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds targets still for his snipe, and teammates who follow up when Back It Up! returns a hero
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Peekaboo! since Knock, Knock! is much stronger on marked targets; after Back It Up! teleports you back, expect a follow-up, and pressure him after Surprise, Surprise! is spent

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses for attack speed → Hail of Arrows slow → Inner Fire barrage
ourKits.winCondition: stack Relentless with basics and abilities to add max-health damage and melt the frontline in long fights
ourKits.passive: Relentless stacks on hit and makes her basics deal bonus max-health damage
ourKits.playWith: peel and a frontline, since her only escape is a short stealth
ourKits.playAgainst: Heightened Senses is her only escape, a brief stealth with speed and no dash, so hard-engage her after it is used; Piercing Shot passes through terrain, so do not hide behind walls at low health

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap and slow, Unleash for maximum attack speed cleaving basics, Cull to lock the target, Invigorate to cleanse and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Stick to one target, build Rage for regen and faster cooldowns, and out-sustain them in long fights.
ourKits.passive: Ancestral Fury builds Rage on hits, giving health regen and faster cooldowns, plus movement speed at high Rage.
ourKits.playAgainst: Buy anti-heal to cut Invigorate and Rage regen. Save your CC until after Invigorate is used since it cleanses, and break off for a few seconds so his Rage decays.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
ourKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
ourKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
ourKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
enemyKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
enemyKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

enemyKits.combo: Web Lash roots a hero or leaps from terrain to knock up and stun, Crushing Maw bites for damage and healing, Hellfire's Demon Eye stacks slows, then Consume pulls enemies into his maw to bite and execute
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Hunger to become Awakened, then win extended fights with Awakened damage reduction, armor shred and Consume executes
enemyKits.passive: dealing and taking damage builds Hunger for more healing; at max Hunger he is Awakened with damage reduction and empowered basic abilities
enemyKits.playWith: teammates with follow-up damage on his Web Lash root who can push targets into Consume execute range
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Web Lash and watch for him lashing to walls before the leap stun; stay out of the Consume cone while he is slowed pulling, and avoid long trades once he is Awakened; buy anti-heal for his Crushing Maw and Consume healing

enemyKits.combo: Saturation Charge mines to slow, Frag Order to launch enemies, Orbital Sanction to track them, Rally Point to knock back divers and heal allies.
enemyKits.winCondition: Hold an area with Orbital Sanction and mines while Rally Point keeps his team healthy and his rifle on infinite ammo.
enemyKits.passive: Ballistic Calibration turns bonus attack speed into ability haste and unlocks ability upgrades at item stat thresholds.
enemyKits.playWith: Frontliners who fight inside Rally Point's heal and hold enemies in the Orbital beam.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Stun him while he cooks Frag Order to make him drop it. Bait Rally Point's knockback before engaging, trade when he reloads, and buy anti-heal against Rally Point's heal and armor against his physical damage.

enemyKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
enemyKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
enemyKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
enemyKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
enemyKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
enemyKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
enemyKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

loadout.name: Sniper's Bounty
loadout.text: Killing Blows from Knock Knock! grant +6g, increased to +40g for Heroes.
loadout.plain: Killing blows with Knock, Knock! give extra gold, a lot more on heroes. Use the sniper shot to last-hit minions and finish fleeing heroes from range.

loadout.name: Satariel
loadout.text: Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless (max 6). Max Health is reduced by 6% (+6.5% melee / +7.5% ranged per Fearless), and you gain 4% (+4% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless stacks are lost on death.
loadout.plain: Takedowns stack big power and attack speed, but lower your max health and you lose stacks on death. Strong for a Wraith who can keep sniping safely from range.

loadout.name: Demonic Bargain
loadout.text: Gain 350 additional Gold at levels 1 and 10.
loadout.plain: Generic: extra gold at levels 1 and 10.

loadout.name: Psychosis
loadout.text: Deal 3% (+0.3% per Level) more damage to the closest Enemy Hero, but 10% less damage to any other Enemy Hero.
loadout.plain: Wraith deals 3% more damage, plus 0.3% per level, to the closest enemy hero but 10% less to every other enemy hero, so a Knock, Knock! snipe on a far target loses damage while a nearer enemy is around.

loadout.name: Ortus
loadout.text: Limit Breaker:  Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
loadout.plain: A burst of speed and physical power, and takedowns during it grant permanent power. Pop it before a pick so your snipe and follow-up hit harder.

loadout.text: Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless (max 6). Max Health is reduced by 6% (+6.5% melee / +7.5% ranged per Fearless), and you gain 4% (+4% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless stacks are lost on death.
loadout.plain: Takedowns stack big power and attack speed, but lower your max health and you lose stacks on death. Strong for a Wraith who can keep sniping safely from range.

loadout.name: Demonic Bargain
loadout.text: Gain 350 additional Gold at levels 1 and 10.
loadout.plain: Generic: extra gold at levels 1 and 10.

loadout.name: Psychosis
loadout.text: Deal 3% (+0.3% per Level) more damage to the closest Enemy Hero, but 10% less damage to any other Enemy Hero.
loadout.plain: Wraith deals 3% more damage, plus 0.3% per level, to the closest enemy hero but 10% less to every other enemy hero, so a Knock, Knock! snipe on a far target loses damage while a nearer enemy is around.

loadout.name: Ortus
loadout.text: Limit Breaker:  Gain 20% Movement Speed and 10% Physical Power for 7s. Takedowns within 7s permanently grant 3 Physical Power and refreshes the duration.
loadout.plain: A burst of speed and physical power, and takedowns during it grant permanent power. Pop it before a pick so your snipe and follow-up hit harder.

countered.text: 1 of the 4 players Wraith killed built physical armor (Akeron).

evidence: 6/1/3, 13089 hero damage, the most in the game.
Hero damage per minute 818 vs their Wraith norm 1166.

bullets: Satariel takedown stacks traded max health for power and attack speed until death; Demonic Bargain added early gold; Psychosis hit the closest enemy hero harder, others softer.
Takedowns reset Surprise, Surprise!, so the same takedowns that built Satariel stacks also brought back the camouflage escape, helping Wraith keep the stacks.
Peekaboo! marks targets, so a Knock, Knock! hit adds bonus max-health damage and cuts the shot's cooldown by 75%; Alternator makes that alternate ability hit 15% harder.

coachLean.headline: We won 5 of 6 fights, lost no duo laner early, and the enemy surrendered after the duo outer tower fell.

flags.text: Wraith led the game with 13,089 hero damage, killed The Fey 3 times and died once.
Sparrow and Steel: 0 early deaths against 4 for Legion and Phase, then the duo outer tower.
First blood, the first Fangtooth off a 3-0 fight and river buffs 11 to 3 went our way.
We cashed 2 of 5 won fights; the enemy took the second Fangtooth with Khaimera and Sparrow down.

focus.action: After every won fight, walk the living team onto the nearest tower or Fangtooth before anyone recalls; river control at 11 to 3 has to end in more than 1 tower.

c8332233-dd6f-4524-ac1b-a273cbae1677: Only 1 death against a usual 5.15, yet 818 hero damage per minute sat under a usual 1,166.
Next game, follow every Khaimera Cull with Knock, Knock! for the pick; Sniper's Bounty pays +40g per hero killing blow.
5bd25494-c2b6-4b66-b80e-48c70045a6ac: Credited in all 6 skirmishes: 6 kills, 59% kill participation and 5,082 objective damage, the most on the team.
Next game, save Inner Fire until Shield Slam and Cull land, and wait out Akeron Consume before stepping in.
7abb0d85-3518-4fc7-b092-6d96002ae365: Set the early tempo: first blood on The Fey, 4 kills, 1 death and 5,868 healing through 20,301 damage taken.
Died in the fight before the second Fangtooth, which the enemy took; next game, chain Cull only as Shield Slam ends, then hold the pit.
e5d4650e-e858-4870-8578-27590890c660: Two deaths against a usual 5.25, but 0 kills, 6% kill participation and no completed item on 5,405 gold.
Next game, fight after Aurora Hoarfrost is spent and land the knock-up as Cull ends: Aurora landed one of the two deaths.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Kill participation hit 59% with 9 assists, 3,392 healing and 9,726 mitigated, on 1 death.
Wards fell to 7 against a usual 11.8; next game, open fights with Shield Slam on the group so Cull and Right Crunch chain.
